name: What preparations do I need to make before a window sill installation appointment?

mainEntity.name: What preparations do I need to make before a window sill installation appointment?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before your window sill installation appointment, please clear the area around the windows. This includes moving furniture, removing existing window treatments like blinds or curtains, and taking down any decor from the sill or surrounding wall. Ensuring a clear workspace allows our installers to work efficiently and safely. If the existing sill needs to be removed, any delicate items nearby should be secured. Our team will handle the core installation, but a clear path and workspace greatly assist the process.
acceptedAnswer.description: Before installation, clear the area around windows by moving furniture, removing window treatments, and any decor to ensure a clear and safe workspace for installers.
